note: Redistribution basis for every source under datasets/. sources.json is regenerated by the fetchers and is not tracked, so the licensing record lives here. 'verified' means the terms page was read on the recorded date and quoted; 'distributed' says whether the source's runtime tables are included in the public data archive (FinAgenticBench-data.zip). A source whose terms do not grant, or do not state, a right to redistribute is not distributed; users rebuild it from the publisher with the scripts under scripts/ingest/ (docs/data_release.md).

bases.us_federal_public_domain: Work of the United States Government, 17 U.S.C. 105; no copyright, no redistribution restriction. Applies to SEC, Federal Reserve, Treasury, FDIC, FFIEC, NCUA, BLS, BEA, Census, CFTC, EIA, FEMA, NOAA, SBA, DOL, HMDA/CFPB, OFR, EPA, USAspending, OFAC.
bases.bis_terms: Terms of permitted use of BIS statistics (https://data.bis.org/help/legal): 'The use of the statistics is unrestricted, provided that' the BIS is cited as the source, the use is not potentially misleading (no implied endorsement or affiliation), inclusion in a commercial product adds no charge, and the BIS's disclaimer of accuracy, completeness and fitness, and of investment advice, is respected.
bases.ken_french: Kenneth R. French Data Library (https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/data_library.html): the pages carry only the line 'Copyright Eugene F. Fama and Kenneth R. French' and state no terms of use or redistribution.
bases.gleif_cc0: GLEIF Golden Copy is published under CC0 1.0.
bases.philadelphia_fed: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Real-Time Data Set for Macroeconomists (https://www.philadelphiafed.org/surveys-and-data/real-time-data-research/real-time-data-set-for-macroeconomists): 'The data set may be used by macroeconomic researchers to verify empirical results, to analyze policy, or to forecast'; the site's Online Terms of Use (https://www.philadelphiafed.org/about-us/privacy-notice) limit content to 'informational, educational, and research purposes only' and say 'Some of the content on this website may be copyrighted. Permission to use such copyrighted material must be obtained from the owner.' Redistribution is not addressed. Preferred citation: Croushore and Stark, Journal of Econometrics 105 (2001), 111-130.
bases.nyfed_terms: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Terms of Use (https://www.newyorkfed.org/privacy/termsofuse, last updated 2023-06-09): a non-exclusive licence to 'use, copy, and distribute Content for your personal or business purposes', on condition that the copyright notice and source identifiers are kept, that the Content is distributed 'with the same permissions, conditions, and restrictions set forth in these Terms', and that reference-rate data carry the notice and disclaimer prescribed under 'Reference Rates'.
bases.finra_terms: FINRA Terms of Use (https://www.finra.org/terms-of-use, last modified 2023-11-09): content 'shall be used ONLY for your own non-commercial personal or professional use' and 'may not be copied, reproduced, transmitted, ... distributed ... without FINRA's prior written consent'; users may not 'develop or create a database of data using the FINRA Website'. No right to redistribute.

bis.required_notice: NOTICE.md in the data archive cites the BIS as the source and reproduces its disclaimer.

finra_short_volume.reason: The Terms of Use permit only personal non-commercial use and require written consent for distribution.

ken_french.reason: No written terms grant redistribution; the files carry only a copyright line.

nyfed_rates.required_notice: NOTICE.md in the data archive carries the reference-rate notice, the DTCC credit and the attribution line the Terms require.

rtdsm.reason: The terms permit research use and do not address redistribution; some site content is stated to be copyrighted.
